targets.title: Adapt and evaluate additional classical CDCL heuristics for CDCL(⊕).
targets.gate: Specify the heuristic variant, input family, resource measure and comparison baseline.

targets.title: Develop CNF-specific parity branching and adaptive clause-versus-variable heuristics.
targets.gate: Specify a CNF family and parity branching objective, including the proposed role of bijective pigeonhole formulas.

targets.title: Characterize a semantic parity analogue of1-UIP for the output of Algorithm3.
targets.gate: Define the parity implication/cut semantics and the exact1-UIP property beyond being asserting.

targets.title: Semantically characterize clause minimization and generalize it faithfully to CDCL(⊕).
targets.gate: Specify classical minimization semantics and the required faithfulness of the parity extension.

applicability: General parity-clause reasoning is relevant to our XOR plus compatibility constraints. The solver and proof format are tested separately; no C16 consequence follows from the simulation theorem or benchmark results alone.
current_status_limit: No exhaustive present-resolution or Lean search for these directions. Current upstream0.2-dev includes experimental restart options, a partial implementation fact rather than a resolution of the broad source direction.
